main.description: A secret poll, step one. The caller blinds one random 32-byte token per unit of their weight (RFC 9474, RSABSSA-SHA384-PSS-Randomized, under the poll's `issuer_pubkey`) and the server signs each without being able to read it. Served once per voter. Asking again with the SAME blinded tokens answers with the same signatures, so a reply lost on the way does not cost a vote; different tokens are refused. The server records that the voter was served, and neither what they were given nor when.

blinded.description: Exactly `viewer.weight` blinded tokens, base64url without padding.

signatures.description: One blind signature per blinded token, in order, base64url without padding.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such poll, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.description: The caller did not hold voting rights when the poll opened (HTTP 403).

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller's weight in this poll went to a delegate.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Not a secret poll, the wrong number of tokens, or a token the key cannot sign.

errors.name: AlreadyIssued
errors.description: The caller was already served, with other tokens (HTTP 409).
